what: Line-drawn vehicles (truck · bicycle · bird) are tied to scroll and draw a straight diagonal from off-screen at the top right (horizontal 55% + own width + 16px, vertical −screen height×.55 − own height − 16px) to off-screen at the bottom left. It starts when the board head is 150% below the screen, runs over a descent of twice the screen height, and follows .6s late. Rewinding upward flips left and right (scaleX −1) so it runs backward. At 480px and below the vertical span is reduced to .35

options.y: Vertical width (multiple of screen height), default .55
options.narrow: Window width (px) or below treated as a narrow screen, default 480
options.flip: If false, does not flip back on rewind
